title: Sustainable Cities
description: Explores the opportunities and challenges of creating ecologically-minded, resilient, healthy, and socially just cities with a practical, community-engaged focus.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GEOG 406, GEOG 506.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate course.

International students interested in taking GEOG 406 should contact the International Centre for Students (ICS) to discuss potential work authorization requirements for the experiential learning component of this course.
